title: Hymn index prints 'Doctor egregie' (LHym 469) as 25/3 L (Annunciation); the body prints it at 25/1 Lauds (Conversion of St Paul)
prompt: The hymn index (p1217) lists #109 'Doctor egregie' (LHym 469, gregobase:4250) as 25/3 L, so it holds annunciation LAUDS.hymn option 1. The Annunciation body (p756) prints only 'Laudes H O lux salutis nuntia (LHym 363)' (row #220, held as r5882). The body prints Doctor egregie on p709 (Conversion of St Paul, 25/1): 'Laudes H Doctor egregie, ex hymno Iam bone pastor (LHym 468), prima stropha omissa'. The other 25/1 hymns are #120 Excelsam Pauli (V) and #249 Pressi malorum (Ol), so 25/3 looks like a misprint for 25/1 (same class as #25, 28/12 → 28/10). Note that the body cites LHym 468 while the index says 469.
